name: Activity History - Disable
description: Stops Windows from publishing or uploading user activities while preserving clipboard history.
whatItDoes: Disables Windows activity history tracking and cloud synchronization.
sideEffects: Task View timeline and cross-device task resume features will not remember recent application history.

name: Hibernation - Disable
description: Turns off hibernation and Fast Startup and deletes hiberfil.sys to free disk space. Laptops lose the Hibernate option.

apply.script:
powercfg.exe /hibernate off
      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "powercfg failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

undo.script:
powercfg.exe /hibernate on
      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "powercfg failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

whatItDoes: Disables Windows system hibernation and fast startup using powercfg.exe.
sideEffects: System hibernation is removed, increasing boot time slightly when starting from a cold power-off state; frees several gigabytes from hiberfil.sys.

name: Widgets - Remove
description: Removes the annoying widgets in the bottom left of the Taskbar.

apply.script:
Get-Process *Widget* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      Get-AppxPackage Microsoft.WidgetsPlatformRuntime -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      Get-AppxPackage MicrosoftWindows.Client.WebExperience -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

warnings: Uninstalls the Windows Widgets Platform and WebExperience AppX packages for all users. Undo restores taskbar registry settings, but does NOT reinstall the removed AppX packages.
irreversibleReason: Uninstalls Microsoft Widgets and WebExperience AppX packages for all users; undo only restores taskbar visibility registry keys and does not reinstall the packages.
whatItDoes: Removes Windows Widgets Platform and WebExperience AppX packages for all users.
sideEffects: Uninstalls the Windows Widgets taskbar button and news flyout permanently. Irreversible.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Taskbar items › Widgets
effectNote: Windows 11 only. Windows 10 News and Interests is not affected.

name: Start Menu Previous Layout - Enable
description: Bring back the old Start Menu layout from before the gradual rollout of the new one in 25H2. On newer versions of Windows !!THIS TWEAK WILL NOT WORK!!
whatItDoes: Reverts Start Menu to previous layout on compatible Windows builds.
sideEffects: Overrides newer Start Menu redesigns; will not take effect on incompatible newer build revisions.
effectNote: Only works on Windows 11 24H2/25H2 builds where the new Start menu is rolling out and the override is still honored.

name: Microsoft Store Recommended Search Results - Disable
description: Will not display recommended Microsoft Store apps when searching for apps in the Start menu.
sideEffects: Denies access to store.db, which can cause Microsoft Store search and package downloads to error or freeze.
whatItDoes: Restricts file system permissions on Microsoft Store local database (store.db).

name: Location Tracking - Disable
whatItDoes: Disables Windows Location Platform and sensor services machine-wide.
sideEffects: System clock timezone auto-detection, Weather app, and location-based maps will not be able to determine your physical location.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Privacy & security › Location › Location services

name: Services - Disable or Set to Manual
description: Disables Offline Files, telemetry and Internet Connection Sharing services, sets Maps and Storage services to Manual, and raises SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB to the installed RAM to reduce svchost.exe processes. Restart required.
whatItDoes: Sets background services (CscService to Disabled, DiagTrack to Disabled, MapsBroker to Manual, StorSvc to Manual, SharedAccess to Disabled) and configures SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB to match physical memory.
sideEffects: Disables Mobile Hotspot and Internet Connection Sharing (SharedAccess), disables Offline Files sync (CscService), and may delay offline map updates (MapsBroker).

name: ConsumerFeatures - Disable
description: Stops promoted app installs and reduces app suggestions from Microsoft Store content.
whatItDoes: Disables automatic installation of promoted third-party apps and suggested store apps via CloudContent policy.
sideEffects: Prevents Windows from automatically downloading recommended games and promotional apps upon setup.
effectNote: Ignored on Home and Pro; works only on Enterprise and Education.

name: Telemetry - Disable
whatItDoes: Sets AllowTelemetry to 0, turns off advertising ID, tailored experiences, online speech, inking and typing data collection, disables the DiagTrack and WerSvc services and Defender automatic sample submission.
sideEffects: Reduces telemetry reported to Microsoft; Windows Insider preview builds and Feedback Hub may show diagnostic warnings.

name: Restore Point - Create
description: Creates a System Restore point now (turning on System Restore for the system drive if needed) and removes the 24-hour limit between restore points.

apply.script:
Enable-ComputerRestore -Drive "$Env:SystemDrive\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Checkpoint-Computer -Description "WinVelo restore point" -RestorePointType MODIFY_SETTINGS

whatItDoes: Enables System Restore protection on the system drive and creates an immediate restore point checkpoint.
sideEffects: Allocates and reserves system storage space (typically several gigabytes) for Volume Shadow Copy restore points.

name: Windows Platform Binary Table (WPBT) - Disable
description: If enabled, WPBT allows your computer vendor to execute programs at boot time, such as anti-theft software, software drivers, as well as force install software without user consent. Poses potential security risk.
whatItDoes: Disables Windows Platform Binary Table (WPBT) execution in the registry.
sideEffects: Blocks OEM firmware-injected executables on motherboard boot; certain vendor-specific utility software may fail to load.

name: Prevent Device Companion Apps
description: Stops Windows from downloading device metadata (pictures, info and associated device apps) from the internet when you connect a device.
whatItDoes: Prevents Windows from downloading device icons and metadata from the internet.
sideEffects: Connected printers, monitors, and peripherals in Device Manager will display generic hardware icons instead of branded device images.

name: Disk Cleanup - Run
description: Runs Disk Cleanup silently and removes old Windows Update components.
warnings: Purges superseded Windows update components via DISM /ResetBase. Once executed, superseded updates cannot be rolled back. Undo only resets CleanMgr registry flags.
irreversibleReason: Executes DISM ResetBase and CleanMgr which permanently purge superseded Windows update components; deleted update baselines cannot be restored.
whatItDoes: Sets StateFlags0001 for the Temporary Files, Recycle Bin, Update Cleanup, Delivery Optimization Files and Temporary Setup Files handlers, runs Disk Cleanup silently with /sagerun:1, then runs DISM /StartComponentCleanup /ResetBase.
sideEffects: Empties the Recycle Bin and deletes temporary files, downloaded update files and old Windows Update components. Installed updates can no longer be uninstalled. Can take a long time.

name: Temporary Files - Remove
warnings: Permanently empties all user and system temp folders. Files deleted from temp cannot be recovered. Undo only resets the StorageSense registry flag.
irreversibleReason: Permanently deletes all files in user and system TEMP directories; deleted temporary files cannot be restored.
sideEffects: Deletes files in the user and Windows temp folders. Files in use by running programs are skipped. Deleted files cannot be restored.

name: File Explorer Automatic Folder Discovery - Disable
description: Windows Explorer automatically tries to guess the type of the folder based on its contents, slowing down the browsing experience. WARNING! Will disable File Explorer grouping.

apply.script:
$bags = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags"
      $bagMRU = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\BagMRU"
      Remove-Item -Path $bags -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      Remove-Item -Path $bagMRU -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      $allFolders = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags\AllFolders\Shell"
      if (!(Test-Path $allFolders)) {
        New-Item -Path $allFolders -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
      }

whatItDoes: Resets saved folder views and sets FolderType to NotSpecified for all folders, so File Explorer stops guessing folder types (Pictures, Music, etc.) from their contents.
sideEffects: All saved folder view settings are reset. Folders use the generic layout; date grouping in Downloads and media columns are no longer applied automatically.
